# Matt Krall

> Matt Krall is an executive coach and leadership advisor, former President and COO, and co-founder of Elevate You. He works with senior executives and operators who know their strategy is sound but want to understand why execution still breaks down under pressure.

Matt's work centers on reducing the interference between what capable people know and what they can consistently access when pressure is live (Performance = Potential − Interference, W. Timothy Gallwey). His Ripple Effect sequence — Awareness, Alignment, Activation, Amplification — describes how significant change follows a sequence.

## Background
Executive roles: President of PREMIER Bankcard; Chief Operating Officer of Credit One Bank; Senior Vice President, Operations at Corpay/FLEETCOR; Marketing Execution Leader at GE Retail Consumer Finance; Group Manager at Capital One. University of Notre Dame graduate. Based in Sioux Falls, South Dakota. Featured in LEADERS — Shaping Organizational Transformation in 2026 (USA Leaders).

## How to start
Start with the Identity Audit: https://mattkrall.com/identity-audit — an optional, complimentary 30-minute Clarity Conversation follows if useful.
